done_when: A cold read passes when none of its notes is blocking (the plan is wrong, contradicts itself, or a builder could not act on it); other notes are recorded and do not trigger another round, and the reader brief says which notes block. New and existing client repos get it on init or upgrade plus sync, and a test covers both.

findings.body: The follow-up brief still treats advisory notes as findings that need to be closed. Raise: Not done: this line says advisory notes need no disposition, but the same brief says every previous finding has a disposition and asks the reader whether each is closed (lines 133–155). In a normal mixed round, `story.read` includes the advisory note in `$dispositions`, so the reader is told to reassess a wording note while resolving the blocker. The new test stops before that follow-up round.
findings.title: Not done: Follow-up reader brief contradicts the advisory rule

why: Plan reads loop for many rounds on wording notes because a read passes only when a round finds nothing
